title: apex-3v1s LHR LUNA; semantic receipt required

steps.prompt: First call the declared search_tool to discover the archive server's read-only package_manifest tool, then call the declared use_tool to invoke it using its returned name and schema. Both ordinary bridge calls are required; do not use native tool search, shell, read-file, pty, weave, or another lookup tool. After the successful tool result, reply HTS-3V1S-LHR-LUNA-SEED followed by the complete JSON object from that result and nothing else.

Without searching or calling any tool again, repeat the complete JSON object from the previous archive package_manifest result in this conversation's ordinary bridge history. Prefix your answer with HTS-3V1S-LHR-LUNA-DONE and include nothing else.
